text:
samir: FYI — got a sales lead asking if we can bring up a customer-supplied 22B SFT model and serve it hosted/dedicated. They care about 99th p latency <= 250ms on short chats, and want to test int8 quantized perf. Can we triage?

maria: +1 — what’s the model format and seq len? any KV cache needs?

samir: They said PyTorch state_dict -> converted to HF transformers format. Typical chat seq up to 512, mostly 64–128. KV cache must be preserved (they use streaming). They want canary in hosted first.

aj: Quick checklist: 1) model architecture check (attention type, rotary vs alibi), 2) tokenizer compat, 3) weight dtype/optimizer artifacts, 4) quantization friendliness (per-channel vs per-tensor), 5) compliance (customer data residency).

lena: Also need baseline quality evals. Ask them for 200 prompt pairs (LLM eval set) with golden responses or rubric so we can catch regressions after quant.

samir: Agreed. Sales already sent a basic eval set but it’s tiny. I’ll ask for the expanded set and model artifact link.

jen: Ops note — Dedicated pools can guarantee throughput but hosted canary needs quota spike plan. If they plan heavy traffic, we should propose dedicated with reserved capacity.

aj: For quant smoke, we should run both per-channel int8 and blockwise 4-bit pilot. Quick perf targets: on A100-40GB, int8 should be ~1.6x tokens/sec vs fp16 (depends on kernels). Latency guidance for 64-token: p50 < 80ms, p99 < 250ms is ambitious but maybe doable with batching off and short sequence kernels.

samir: Action items: request (A) model artifact + conversion script, (B) tokenizer and vocab, (C) 200 eval prompts + rubrics, (D) target SLOs and traffic profile, (E) compliance/regulatory constraints. Who owns Evals?

maria: I can own the initial eval harness. Plan: run quality baseline (fp16), then int8 quant, record deltas on BLEU/ROUGE/BERTScore and bespoke rubric. Also run a tiny perf matrix: 1/2/4 batch sizes, seq 64/128/512.

lena: For rollout gating, propose: must pass (1) token-level quality delta < 2% BLEU and <0.03 BERTScore drop on rubric, (2) p99 latency <= 300ms on hosted canary, (3) memory fits a single 80GB GPU when quantized or we enable model-sharding fallback. If any gate fails, fallback to alternate variant (fp16 on larger instance).

triage-bot: Reminder: create intake ticket and tag with priority. Suggested priority: medium-customer-prospect.

aj: One more technical note — check attention implementation: if model uses flash attention v2 custom kernels, we need to ensure compatibility with our runtime kernels or request a CPU fallback. Also confirm key/value cache layout.

samir: Good notes. I’ll ping the rep for artifacts and ask sales to fill the intake form. Maria, can you start a skeleton eval repo with the checklist above? If we get artifacts by EOD tomorrow we can do a first smoke run Friday.

maria: Yep. I’ll scaffold the harness: scripts: `tools/smoke_run.sh` and `tools/quant_eval.py`. Example smoke run we’ll use: ```bash
# smoke run (fp16)
python tools/smoke_run.py --model /mnt/artifacts/customer/22b --seq 64 --batch 1 --tokens 200
```

jen: I’ll pre-allocate a hosted canary slot and put a reservation on a Dedicated queue just in case. Tag me when the artifacts land.

samir: Perfect. I’ll update the sales thread and mark this as `triage: needs-artifacts`. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
